notes.title: Major fix 1.10
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players, following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/939850/view/3653012651432224817?l=english]Man Of Medan’s patch[/url], [b]version 1.10 of Little Hope is now available[/b] as well.​
Once again, we [b]apologise for any issues encountered[/b] while playing the game and [b]thank you for your patience[/b].​[/h3]
​
[h3]This patch includes:​[/h3]
✔️ Fixed multiple issues with older save files getting corrupted​
✔️ Improved stability and overall game performance​
✔️ Fixed several issues with Collectables and Bearings​
✔️ Fixed issues with menu text visibility​
✔️ Improved online lobby connectivity​
​​
​Some players might encounter the same corrupted save files issue as for the Man Of Medan fix.​
Players who played the game after the previous update using pre-existing save games are likely to be affected.​
​
[b]​Please accept our sincere apologies if you are amongst the players concerned by this problem.​[/b]

[h3]The free PC update for Little Hope now includes:[/h3]
•	[b]New difficulty settings[/b] & QTE warnings,
•	[b]Improved UI[/b] & interactions,
•	Updated bearing art & event triggers,
•	[b]Increased walking speeds[/b],
•	[b]More accessibility options[/b], including subtitle sizing,

Thank you for your continued support of The Dark Pictures Anthology​.

notes.title: Man Of Medan gets new free chapter in surprise update for The Dark Pictures Anthology
notes.content:
It’s usually nice to see older games get updates, particularly when we’re not expecting it. Think of it as a good jump scare. Supermassive Games have given their first two The Dark Pictures Anthology some extra care and attention today, dropping in new difficulty settings and accessibility options, tweaked UI, and even faster walking for characters. There’s also an extended chapter for Man Of Medan. I didn’t think update trailers were a thing but there’s one for this, which you can watch below.

Read more

notes.title: New Patch is Live!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing [b]Little Hope[/b], the second installment in The Dark Pictures Anthology!
We want you to enjoy this horror experience to the fullest, so we’re committed to addressing bugs and performance issues that may arise. Thank you so much for your patience as we work towards fixing them. 
Today we’re pleased to announce that we're finally releasing the first official patch for Little Hope on [b]Steam[/b]! 

[b]Patch 1.04[/b] implements the following:
[list]
[*] General improvements to character-object interaction
[*] General improvements to character controls
[*] General multiplayer stability fixes
[*] Additional missing audio in localized voice-over
[*] Players with a save data for Man of Medan will be welcomed differently by the Curator
[*] Fixes issues where the player appears to fall out of the world
[/list]

A big thank you to everyone who submitted reports, they’ve helped us immensely! We’ll continue to monitor any further issues and publish patches where necessary. 

Please don’t hesitate to contact our support teams if you spot any more bugs: 
EU: [url=https://bnent.eu/TDP_Support]https://bnent.eu/TDP_Support[/url]   
US: [url=https://fcld.ly/lh_support_us ]https://fcld.ly/lh_support_us [/url]
